title: Welcome to Fashion Design English
summary: Students learn the Week 1 course rhythm, complete a light diagnostic, build starter vocabulary for Fashion Design study, and produce a short bilingual-supported English profile they can reuse in later speaking and portfolio work.
essential_question: How can English help me introduce myself and participate in Fashion Design study from the first week?
professional_context: Week 1 connects English directly to first-semester Fashion Design routines, including drawing, sewing, patternmaking, creativity, text production, and the habit of explaining personal interests and study goals in a studio context.
grammar_focus: I am a fashion design student
teacher_preparation: Review the Week 1 manual sequence and keep the tone welcoming, visual, and low-pressure.
Preview the reading text, listening script, and vocabulary image set before class.
Prepare a pronunciation list for fashion design, sketch, fabric, garment, sewing, patternmaking, studio, and portfolio.
Decide whether students will draft the profile on paper, in a shared document, or in a future app text-response field.
Plan how to monitor the teacher-led speaking session and note which students need extra support with sentence frames.
student_deliverables: Completion of the orientation and diagnostic task.
Reading-comprehension responses about a model Fashion Design student.
Listening-comprehension responses about a first-semester Fashion Design student.
Completion of the starter vocabulary practice set.
A 50-80 word Fashion Design student profile in English.
One corrected sentence saved after feedback review.
A short oral self-introduction during the teacher-led session.
